engineVersion: allocation-d6-signal-ridge-api.1; D4 exact parametric-QP / quadprog@D4.2; D4 D4 exact parametric-QP / quadprog@D4.2

solver.name: D4 exact parametric-QP / quadprog
solver.message: Exact square-root robust objective KKT stationarity and independent primal feasibility checks passed.

source.priceConvention: persisted adjusted-close prices; not broker-level corporate-action accounting

ridge.target: asset arithmetic close-to-close return minus daily cash return over the same interval
ridge.horizon: one close-to-close interval after execution close
ridge.uncertaintyLabel: Approximate sampling uncertainty of the penalized fitted forecast.

portfolio.label: Expected return estimation uncertainty; not portfolio return volatility.

forecast.intervalLabel: Approximate fitted-forecast sampling-uncertainty interval; NOT a future-return prediction interval.
forecast.uncertaintyAssumption: Date-aggregated Bartlett HAC sandwich covariance conditional on fixed ridge penalty and train-only scaler; excludes shrinkage bias, omitted-model/regime uncertainty, and future residual return noise. Not a calibrated confidence guarantee.

sensitivity.name: shrinkage
sensitivity.reason: No selected D3 shrinkage parameter applies to this forecast configuration.

sensitivity.name: tau
sensitivity.reason: Tau sensitivity requires BAYESIAN_VIEWS with TAU_SIGMA prior uncertainty.

sensitivity.name: factorCount
sensitivity.reason: Factor-count sensitivity requires an explicit STATISTICAL_FACTOR model count.
